usage: speechloom setup [-h] [--backend {auto,cpu,cuda,vulkan}]
                        [--features FEATURES] [--from-source] [--keep-cache]
                        [--json]
                        {status,clean} ...

positional arguments:
  {status,clean}
    status              Verify managed installation state
    clean               Remove managed setup caches

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --backend {auto,cpu,cuda,vulkan}
  --features FEATURES   Comma-separated: translation,diarization
  --from-source         Build the runtime from pinned source
  --keep-cache          Keep converter and model caches
  --json                Emit machine-readable setup results
